summary: Receives CHOP data from a local or global shared-memory segment written by Shared Mem Out CHOP in the same or another process.
key_concepts: Shared Mem In CHOP receives CHOP data from a shared-memory segment written by Shared Mem Out CHOP.
The operator is available only in TouchDesigner Educational, Commercial, and Pro licenses.
Active controls whether the CHOP cooks and reads from the memory block.
Shared Mem Name identifies the memory block to read.
Shared Mem Type selects Local mode for a segment unique to the given name or Global mode for the combined shared-memory segment.
Use Pipe In CHOP when pipe-style channel transfer is a better fit than local shared-memory IPC.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Cook and read from the memory block

key_params.name: local
key_params.note: Use a shared-memory segment unique for the given name

key_params.name: global
key_params.note: Use the combined global shared-memory segment

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root path for automatic channel-name exports

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT table export methods

common_gotchas: Official docs list this as available only in Educational, Commercial, and Pro licenses.
Local mode creates a unique segment for the given name and is required for sharing with applications other than TouchDesigner.
Global mode uses a combined segment that all nodes read from; coordinate naming and ownership carefully.
The writer side must use a matching Shared Mem Out CHOP name and compatible memory type.
For lower-bandwidth command-style data, Pipe In CHOP or DAT protocols may be a simpler fit.
Shared-memory workflows are local/process IPC, not a network transport.
